raw_comment: I noticed that most of the droughts that are more extreme and exceptional occur in the middle of the United States where there is no bodies of water nearby. I also noticed that the far East and West sides of the United States where they are near large bodies of water don't have many droughts and are not as severe as the droughts in the center. I wonder about the effects that these extreme droughts have on the center of the United States. This graph relates to my community because I now know that in Long Island, New York droughts are moderate, and this is where I live. A headline for this graph could be "How bad can droughts be in your area".
